label: Delactosed permeate
step: what stays after the lactose crystallises
note: Despite the name it still holds a lot of lactose and most of the salts, chloride and phosphate above all.

about.text: What is left of whey permeate after lactose has been crystallised out and spun off. It keeps the minerals, the lactose that would not crystallise and small nitrogen compounds, and goes mostly into animal feed, or on to milk-mineral and lactic acid production.

steps.name: evaporate
steps.note: Evaporated to 60-62 % dry matter (whey) or 65 % (nanofiltered permeate).
Seeded, then cooled slowly in crystallisers; crystals over 0.2 mm separate best.

steps.name: centrifuge
steps.note: Spun off in two decanter centrifuges in series, leaving a lactose cake under 9 % moisture and about 99 % dry solids.
